person_note: The book's controlling narration is third person, specifically limited third person shifting among several focal characters. Numerous Goodreads event passages independently show a nonparticipating narrator referring to focal characters as he or she while entering their thoughts, knowledge, memories, and sensations. First-person forms in the quote set occur in dialogue, aphorisms, or isolated local voice, including q01937 and q01984, and do not constitute autonomous first-person narrative sections. This agrees with the author's explicit whole-book description, the authorized opening excerpt, and the CliffsNotes structural account. The shifting viewpoint characters therefore do not warrant ALTERNATING because every sustained base section remains third person; no material uncertainty remains. Quote audit: three locally nondiagnostic action/speech-beat passages were conservatively marked unmarked; the book label is unchanged.
